preconditions: Independent Primary4 financial-concept, inclusion and rubric review before classroom delivery.
Use paper or an offline drawing tool only, fictional labels and no private account information; no account opening, actual money transfer, borrowing or investment.
Original shapes and captions, not copied logos or currency reproductions; classroom infographic is not personal advice or an official financial-system chart.
evidenceRequirements: Examiner must see the pupil’s actual infographic and identify the pupil’s own contribution against each criterion. A plan or group attendance alone is not performance.
